## Interpretation

Cleanest finite-size scaling among the current scans; close to the Ising-limit expectation.

Working critical-kappa diagnostics:

- Linear Binder crossing band: `0.338497-0.340935` from 5 pair/center entries.
- Mean linear Binder crossing: `0.339628`.
- Linear extrapolation of susceptibility peak locations versus `1/L`: `0.340296` with RMS residual `0.000063`.
- Susceptibility peak-height fit: `chi_abs,max ~ L^p`, `p = 1.725598`.
